turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
We've barely started, Hale. My call isn't until 4:40, and you haven't answered me. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved, and you won't write that down on my word. The zero comes off, and I want to hear what you have besides a score.
I've answered that. If "resolved" goes in a file with my name next to it, I'm in the principal's office within the hour. Withdraw the zero, Hale.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
I'm writing down that you've asked me four times to agree to something you haven't explained. I'll say okay when the zero is withdrawn and not before. What are you putting in that write-up?
